To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The 4q35 D4Z4 locus is a chromatin hub, whose spatial organization and gene expression are modified in patients with Facio- Scapulo Humeral Dystrophy.

the 3D chromatin organization of the 5' region of 4q is modified in FSHD patients, that these modifications are inherited after reprogramming, and that the D4ZA macrosatellite repeat plays a key role in this organization.
the D4z4 repeat is involved in the 3D folding of chromatin at 4q35.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the chromatin organization of the 3D genome in FSHD patients, and its role in transcriptional regulation.
the 3D structure of the D4z4 locus in FSH and the impact of this 3D structure on gene expression.
the role of the 3D structure of the 4Q35 locus on FSHD pathophysiology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the D4 Z4 macrosatellite array is a key element for the 3D chromatin organization of the 3q35 locus and that the altered chromatin organization is a hallmark of FSHD.
D4Z2 contraction and/or SMCHDC1 mutation impact the 3D chromatin structure of the 4 q35 locus.
the 3D architecture of the 4 q35 locus is altered in FSHD and that this alteration is associated with a modulation of 4q3 5 genes expression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chromatin organization at 4q35 is altered in FSHD and this alteration is associated with changes in the expression level of several 4q35 gene.
FSHD is a disease in which a chromatin structure change is the first hit and that the resulting altered transcriptional program is the second hit, leading to a muscle disease.
the D4ZA repeat is involved in the 3D folding of the 3q35 region and the changes in the spatial organization of this region are linked to the transcriptional changes of a number of 4q3 genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
D4Z2 and D4Z4 repeats are involved in the folding of the 3D genome and in the modulation of gene expression.
D4Z 4-dependent chromatin organization plays a critical role in the transcriptional regulation of 4q 35 genes.
the 4q locus is a highly complex chromosomal region that requires the D4Z repeat for its proper organization.
